cards.prompt: A corticosteroid belongs to which broad category of medicine, and what is its signature effect on the body?
cards.answer: It is a synthetic steroid medication, and its signature effect is reducing inflammation.
cards.explanation: Because it calms inflammation fast, it gets used across many very different conditions.

cards.prompt: A pharmacy shelf lists four drugs. Which one is NOT one of the common corticosteroids (Prednisone, Cortisone, Hydrocortisone, Methylprednisone)?
cards.answer: Ibuprofen — it is not a corticosteroid; the four common corticosteroids are prednisone, cortisone, hydrocortisone and methylprednisone.

cards.prompt: Among anti-inflammatory options, corticosteroids are described as the ____ way to bring inflammation down.
Claim: The side effects of corticosteroids are the same whether you take them for a few days or for months.
cards.answer: Myth — side effects increase the longer the medication is taken.
cards.explanation: This is why doctors often aim for the shortest course that still works.

cards.prompt: Besides inflammatory conditions like lupus, asthma and eczema, what kind of problem can corticosteroids also be used for?
cards.answer: An injury (for example, treating it with a steroid).

cards.prompt: Three of these are known side effects of corticosteroids. Which one does not belong?
cards.answer: Sharper eyesight — the listed side effects are increased appetite, muscle weakness, skin changes and weight gain.

cards.prompt: Your friend sprains an ankle and the doctor offers a cortisone shot straight into the painful joint. How does this fit with what corticosteroids are, and why inject instead of a pill?
cards.answer: A cortisone shot is simply a corticosteroid given as an injection, which lets the drug act directly on the inflamed spot rather than affecting the whole body.
cards.explanation: It is the same fast anti-inflammatory effect, just delivered to the target area.

cards.prompt: Explain like I'm 10: why does a doctor get more careful about side effects when someone has been on corticosteroids for months instead of days?
cards.answer: Corticosteroids are strong inflammation fighters, but the longer they stay in your body, the more the unwanted effects pile up — bigger appetite, weaker muscles, skin changes and weight gain. So a short course is usually gentler than a long one.
cards.explanation: Side-effect risk scales with duration of use, not just dose.

cards.prompt: I'm a synthetic steroid. I might come as a pill or as a shot aimed right at a sore joint, and my talent is cooling inflammation faster than anything else. What am I?
